body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Honeywell presented its new Bluetooth hands-free portable car kit 'Airlite 900' at the 2009 International CES.

The Honeywell airlite 900 is designed to keep you connected with your friends and family without the constant distraction of holding something to your ear. Designed for use in the car, the Airlite 900 features Bluetooth 2.0 technology with Full Duplex, Digital sound processing.
